review.gallery: Ten distinct original OMNIYAT renders from the LUMENA brochure. DLD inspection thumbnails for project 3758 show the March 2026 construction site at 200 pixels wide. Those images are unsuitable for the card or full-width gallery.
review.location: OMNIYAT’s LUMENA map point is distinct from LUMENA ALTA. Page 16 provides an aerial locator near the existing Business Bay Metro Station. The travel estimates on page 15 are approximate and leave the mode and route unspecified. No proposed station is presented as operational.
review.floorPlans: Two complete current brochure plates cover five office configurations. The internal and external areas add to each printed total. The earlier floor-plan brochure has a different office mix and areas. The newer LUMENA brochure is the source for the on-page layouts. No apartment or bedroom terminology is used.

unavailable: Verified entrance, suitable high-resolution project photography and current complete unit-specific or separate full-floor drawings.
